## Frequently asked questions

What is BombBomb Engage?

BombBomb Engage is our newest video messaging platform, designed to help teams quickly create, send and track personalized videos that strengthen relationships, improve engagement and accelerate business outcomes.

What makes Engage different from the original BombBomb platform?

Engage features a redesigned, intuitive interface, enterprise-grade security and permissions, faster performance, deeper analytics and our powerful new Copilot automation (available with Core + Copilot and Enterprise plans), which ensures your outreach consistently feels personal.

Is Engage replacing the existing BombBomb platform?

No. Your current BombBomb subscription (Essentials and Plus plans) remains fully intact and supported. Engage is designed specifically for customers focused primarily on personalized video outreach rather than advanced marketing automation tools.

What is Copilot?

Copilot (available on Core + Copilot and Enterprise plans) delivers the right video, to the right person, at the right time—with zero manual effort. It automates your team’s video outreach using smart campaigns, team assignments, CRM delivery, and patented fail-safe video backup logic—so no message ever gets missed.

Does Engage include marketing automation tools like forms, drip campaigns or email sequences?

No. Engage currently focuses exclusively on personal video messaging. However, we’re actively exploring integrations with established marketing automation platforms to enhance your experience in the future.

What analytics does BombBomb Engage provide?

Engage delivers robust video analytics, detailed viewer interaction tracking, watch times, response rates and overall engagement metrics—helping you optimize your outreach strategy.

How quickly can I create and send videos with Engage?

Engage offers rapid “speed-to-video”—allowing you to record and share personalized videos instantly, directly from Gmail, Outlook, Salesforce, Outreach, Total Expert and other platforms in your workflow.

Can I integrate BombBomb Engage with my current tech stack?

Yes. Engage integrates seamlessly with top platforms including Outreach, Gmail, Outlook and Total Expert, simplifying your video messaging workflow.

Does BombBomb Engage limit video length or storage?

No—BombBomb Engage provides unlimited video length, storage and uploads. However, we recommend keeping videos concise and focused (generally under 60 seconds) to maximize engagement and response rates.

How is BombBomb Engage priced?

Engage offers flexible plans—Core, Core + Copilot and Enterprise—that scale based on team size, functionality and security needs. Contact our sales team for tailored pricing information.

Can I upgrade from my current BombBomb subscription to Engage?

Currently, Essentials customers can easily upgrade to Engage. Plus customers relying on advanced marketing tools will retain their current features until Engage offers comparable functionality. Please connect with your CSM or sales team for guidance.

Is BombBomb Engage secure and enterprise-ready?

Yes. Engage provides enterprise-level security, including Single Sign-On (SSO), SOC 2 Type II compliance and advanced administrative controls and user permissions.

Does Engage comply with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)?

Yes. BombBomb Engage meets global privacy standards, including GDPR and CCPA, ensuring your data—and your customers’ data—is always secure and compliant.

How can my team start using BombBomb Engage?

Reach out to our sales team to schedule a demo or begin a trial. Premium onboarding is included with our Core + Copilot and Enterprise onboarding is included in Enterprise plans. Additional onboarding and continued support packages are also available for purchase and self-service onboarding resources are available for all plans.

Do you provide training or support for new Engage users?

Yes. Core + Copilot and Enterprise customers receive tailored onboarding and comprehensive user training. Additionally, all users have access to our extensive resource library and responsive support team and onboarding and continued support packages are available for purchase.

What if I need help or encounter an issue?

Our dedicated support team is ready to help via email, live chat or through detailed resources in our Knowledge Base.

Can I migrate my existing BombBomb videos into Engage?

Yes, if your current plan is eligible for upgrade to Engage. Your existing BombBomb video library can be migrated seamlessly into Engage, making your transition smooth and effortless.

What additional features or integrations are planned for Engage?

We have an exciting roadmap, including enhanced AI-driven personalization, deeper analytics and future integrations with leading marketing automation solutions. We’ll keep you informed as new capabilities become available.

How can I provide feedback or request new features?

Your feedback shapes our future. Please reach out to your CSM or provide feedback directly within the app—we actively collect and incorporate customer input into our development process.
